Status: change 2612 has LLM-Review +1 (rebar code review PASS). Verified is queued behind a large CI runner backlog (the fleet is saturated by all the changes currently failing scanner-integration + retries).

LANDING-ORDER CAVEAT (for coordination with the main-green session): 2612 is stacked on 2600, but 2600's OWN tree predates this fix, so 2600 is itself red on scanner-integration (2600 is listed among the affected changes). Gerrit submits bottom-up, so 2612 cannot land until 2600 is green — which requires this one-liner to reach at/below 2600 (rebase 2600 onto this fix, cherry-pick the one-liner into 2600, or land a standalone copy of this fix directly on main). 2612 already PROVES the fix on a 2600 base; the landing topology is the remaining step. Deferring that choice to the operator / main-green session rather than editing 2600 (another session's change).
